castAndSave.oneLive: Only one live ordinary Banishment application may attach to the same creature. An attached target cannot receive a second application; no replacement, stacked cell or timer refresh.
castAndSave.preflightAddendum: Apply BAN-TRANSPORT-CLASS-02 and target-side restrictions before commitment when known. No Escape blocks admissionIntent=ACCEPT because Banishment enters extradimensional travel. Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not block this non-teleport planar displacement. A hidden/new blocker may still defeat establishment after costs commit under ordinary spell integration.
castAndSave.admissionIntent: Before the save, record ACCEPT or RESIST. ACCEPT is voluntary admission whether the target elects failure or actually rolls and fails. RESIST remains forced on a failed save. This Banishment-only predicate is used only where an exact source distinguishes voluntary extradimensional travel.

cell.classification: NEW narrowly scoped temporary Banishment spell-space; names no canonical plane
cell.planeIdentity: A distinct temporary extraplanar spell-cell generated by this spell. It is not identified with any named reviewed plane, afterlife, deity, Heartcell state, soul destination, natural origin or campaign era.
cell.coordinates: Cell-local x=east, y=north, z=up. Floor is z=0. The primary arrives with the center of its horizontal footprint at local (0,0) in its current orientation.
cell.initialGeometry: Initial horizontal extent equals the primary's actual footprint plus 5 feet of clearance on every side; round each total horizontal axis upward to the next 5 feet. Height equals actual occupied body height plus 5 feet overhead, rounded upward to the next 5 feet. Example: Medium 5x5 body with occupied height 6 feet starts in x[-7.5,+7.5], y[-7.5,+7.5], z[0,15]. A Tiny 2.5x2.5 body also receives a 15x15 horizontal cell after rounding.
cell.supportAndEnvironment: The entire current cell floor is level ephemeral support. The cell supplies ordinary light and a nonharmful spell-local sustaining medium sufficient for an admitted body's already-established respiration needs. This grants no stock, harvest, resistance, immunity, amphibious trait or cosmological fact.
cell.boundaries: Cell boundaries are opaque to mundane sight/sound and ordinary line of effect/passage. A source cannot target space beyond the current boundary and rely on later expansion to make that target legal.
cell.voluntaryGeometry: Voluntary body-size/shape changes follow their actual source and BODY_EQUIPMENT_PLAYTEST.md preflight against the current in-cell volume. Banishment does not expand first to legalize a voluntary change.
cell.mandatoryGeometry: An actual mandatory ending/reversion/death/body-lifecycle event is never failed, delayed or negated to preserve cell geometry. Resolve it first under its source. If the resulting current body needs more room, expand the cell outward after the mandatory event, only enough to contain all extant bodies plus 5 feet clearance. Expansion moves no body and creates no new target permission.
cell.materiality: Floor/walls/light/sustaining medium are ephemeral spell boundaries with no inventory identity, sale, harvest or residue.

agencyAndClocks.duration: NEW concentration, maximum 60 elapsed seconds from successful establishment. Record absolute deadline establishment+60 seconds. In initiative, preserve the equivalent tenth future regular-start marker only as a display aid; the absolute deadline controls cross-mode transitions.
agencyAndClocks.agency: Primary and any admitted visitors retain their actual Actions, Bonus Actions, Reactions, movement, concentration, conditions, HP, death saves, resources and class permissions. Banishment itself adds no Incapacitated, restraint, stasis, healing or rest.
agencyAndClocks.clocks: All existing condition, summon, concentration, Opening/Horn, Hunt, Stable/death and other real deadlines continue 1:1. Extra turns/initiative changes do not refresh them.
agencyAndClocks.ending: Caster may end its own concentration through the ordinary no-action concentration permission. Caster Incapacitated/concentration failure/end, the absolute deadline, successful Xi termination, actual dispel/end of this application, or suppression of this Banishment application initiates closure immediately. NEW Banishment-specific suppression rule: because suppression disables the exile/cell effect itself, suppression closes and ends this application rather than pausing it for later resumption.

transportAndCustody.primaryTransport: On successful establishment transport the same selected creature identity and only its genuine noncreature worn/carried gear within actual custody/carrying/dimensional limits.
transportAndCustody.separateBodies: No separate creature is converted into gear. A mount, carried passenger, swallowed separate creature, controlled companion or other distinct creature remains at origin. Before establishment, separate it into a legal origin placement if possible. If actual anatomy/restraint makes separation impossible, establishment fails atomically; paid cast/commit history remains, and the hard-control allowance is not spent because exile never established.
transportAndCustody.tethers: An external tether/fixture does not travel merely because attached. If no current rule permits legal separation and the selected body cannot move intact without transporting another body/fixed structure, establishment fails atomically.
transportAndCustody.objects: Record transported object IDs and custody. Consumed, destroyed, transferred or independently removed objects remain consumed/destroyed/transferred/removed. No ending event duplicates inventory.

admission.externalVisitor: A different creature can enter only through an independently legal source that truly reaches this generated cell, satisfies that source's destination knowledge/perception/range/cost requirements, and designates a fitting unoccupied footprint already inside the current cell. The current 49-source set does not prove a generic route to an unknown cell.
admission.internalCreation: An occupant may create/summon a body only through its actual source and only into a fitting unoccupied footprint it can currently perceive/target inside the cell. Pay the source's real Action/RP/frequency/concentration/command costs. No pre-cast cell expansion may supply missing target space or line of effect.
admission.postEstablishmentExpansion: After a visitor/created body legally establishes in an already-valid in-cell footprint, the cell may expand outward only to restore the ordinary 5-foot clearance around extant bodies. That expansion is not part of source preflight.
admission.effect: Admission does not attach Banishment to the secondary body and grants no reusable return route, destination knowledge, immunity, action or resource. Its own independent lifecycle remains real.

escape.rule: Any occupant may use an independently legal escape/travel source exactly as written, paying its actual costs and satisfying its own destination, perception, range, geometry and blocker requirements. Banishment supplies none of those prerequisites.
escape.primaryEscape: If the primary legally leaves the cell, the Banishment application ends immediately. In that same resolution sequence, BAN-CLOSE-03 settles every remaining secondary body/object, then destroys the cell even if it is already empty. The escaped primary is not pulled back.
escape.secondaryEscape: A secondary body that independently leaves remains at its legal destination and is absent from later closure.
escape.failure: A failed escape spends only source-defined costs/history and leaves the body in the cell.

closure.classification: NEW Banishment-only finite ending. The spell-cell ends; physical fit is then handed to the accepted canonical BODY_EQUIPMENT_PLAYTEST placement-conflict procedure rather than protected closure anchors.
closure.trigger: Every Banishment application ending invokes closure: deadline, concentration end, valid Xi/end/suppression, or primary legal escape. Invoke even for an empty cell; an empty ephemeral cell simply ceases.
closure.originPlane: At successful establishment snapshot the primary target's actual origin-plane identity as an opaque existing plane reference and its fixed world anchor/orientation. The anchor never rides with a later-moving platform/vehicle. This records location only and does not name or settle cosmology.
closure.secondaryAnchors: When a secondary body first legally establishes in the cell, record a deterministic origin-plane closure anchor by projecting its cell-local horizontal/vertical offset from the primary local origin onto the primary's fixed world axes. This creates metadata only: no origin-plane space is reserved, protected, excluded or altered.
closure.looseObjectAnchors: At closure start, carried gear remains with its actual carrier. For each genuinely loose surviving object, project its current cell-local position onto the primary fixed world anchor to obtain an item placement anchor. Consumed/destroyed/escaped objects are absent.
closure.mandatoryPlaneReturn: For every remaining extant body/corpse/object, end the extraplanar spell state and assign it to the snapshotted origin plane before physical placement. This transition is mandatory and is not a voluntary teleport.
closure.endpointBlockerException: NEW narrowly scoped Banishment terminal exception: if a current Dimensional Anchor or other true endpoint transport-prevention predicate would block this mandatory closure transition, ignore only that prevention predicate for the terminal return. Do not ignore physical terrain, occupancy, anatomy, support, death/body removal, item existence or any voluntary-travel rule. This exception grants no future transport privilege and cannot be used for escape or another spell.
creatureOrder: primary current body/corpse if still present
secondary creature bodies by stable admission order
closure.creaturePlacement: For each returned creature/corpse in order, apply BODY_EQUIPMENT_PLAYTEST.md Placement and involuntary endings at that entity's closure anchor: (1) normal current-anatomy space at same position; (2) legal squeeze under COMBAT_ACTION_PLAYTEST.md; (3) nearest legal adjacent placement in the same unobstructed region, using minimum displacement, then greatest overlap with the previous/anchor footprint, then the fixed neutral board order. It cannot pass through a wall, closed barrier or occupied space and does not search farther afield.
closure.multiEntityPlacement: Resolve entities in the stated stable order. A body already legally placed is ordinary occupied space for later entities. If that leaves a later entity with no same-anchor/squeeze/nearest-adjacent candidate, the later entity records a placement conflict; earlier legal placements are not undone.
closure.placementConflictState: If the inherited same-anchor → legal squeeze → nearest legal adjacent/same-unobstructed-region placement procedure produces no legal footprint, Banishment still ends and the cell is destroyed. Preserve the same extant identity on the snapshotted origin plane with placementConflict=true and a fixed closureAnchorReference. NEW BAN-CONFLICT-04 does not create a global body condition: it adds only Banishment-origin conflict semantics. The closureAnchorReference is the creature's logical spatial location for measuring range and evaluating source predicates while no legal occupied footprint exists. Do not grant movement, adjacency, occupancy, cover, squeezing, wall passage, overlap, flanking, support contact or other footprint-dependent benefits merely from that reference. Perception and line of effect are evaluated from the closureAnchorReference through the actual current terrain using the exact source's normal rules; solid barriers can therefore block them. Self-targeting and other effects that do not require a legal occupied footprint may still be used if all of their own prerequisites are met. Actions/Reactions are not categorically forbidden: evaluate each one by its actual activation, component, range, target, perception, path and geometry requirements. Ordinary movement cannot begin because there is no legal occupied footprint/path origin, but an independently legal relocation effect can resolve the conflict if it can lawfully use the anchor reference as its source location and establish a legal destination. All HP, Wounds, conditions, concentration, summon, death and other real clocks continue. Already-attached effects remain attached unless their own source ends them. When an obstruction is actually removed/changed so placement becomes possible, rerun the inherited placement procedure from the same anchor with the then-current anatomy; that mandatory normalization spends no movement and triggers no movement riders. When a legal relocation effect succeeds, move the same identity to its legal destination and clear placementConflict.
closure.fallingAndSupport: Evaluate real terrain/support at the closureAnchorReference for source predicates while placementConflict persists, but do not invent an occupied footprint. A conflicted body does not begin Falling merely because the reference point is unsupported; ordinary Falling begins when the body is actually placed in a legal unsupported footprint or a legal relocation establishes one. If closure itself finds a legal unsupported footprint, place the body there and start ordinary Falling immediately. Banishment never moves the body directly to ground.
closure.objects: After creature handling, settle loose noncreature objects by stable object-ID using the existing equipment rule: place at its anchor/current legal item position or nearest legal adjacent item position; if no legal drop exists, record that item's placement as pending. It continues to exist and is not duplicated, destroyed or used to displace another creature.
closure.deathAndRemoval: Mandatory death, source expiry, concentration ending, Polymorph reversion, actual-0-HP ending, cargo release and other true source events are never failed or delayed for Banishment geometry. A remaining corpse returns as that same corpse. A vanished/expired summon body is not recreated. Hunted Death/finality and ordinary item provenance remain unchanged.
closure.cellEnd: After every remaining identity is either legally placed, recorded as an origin-plane placement conflict/pending item, or confirmed absent, destroy the ephemeral cell immediately. No placement conflict keeps Banishment or its concentration alive.

Protected principal such as Resonance Barrier X, materials, HP, ammunition, charges and uses stay outside these buckets.

If at least one operative Resonance Nexus contains the caster at commitment, apply one total -2 to the combined discountable pre-Dampening buckets, minimum0: reduce creditableBase first, then preNexusExtras. Overlapping Nexuses never stack.

If accepted Resonance Dampening Field applies, add its mandatory +2 RP only after Nexus/ordinary reductions. Dampening is noncreditable and Nexus never subtracts it. A genuine charge/use-only spell with no ordinary RP-price interface still receives this accepted +2 interface; Nexus has no earlier RP bucket to reduce.

Apply one pending final Resonance Influence Ease/Burden to the resulting RP-priced spell amount, minimum0. For Barrier accounting only, Ease reduces creditableBase first, then remaining preNexusExtras, then Dampening/other noncreditable final components; Burden adds only noncreditable cost.
Commit the final affordable RP amount together with Action/components/concentration transition. Countering, suppression, save/failure or replacement gives no refund.
AC5-PRICE-01.barrierCreditAllocation: Resonance Barrier pool credit = 5 × (final creditableBasePaid + protectedX). No Dissonance, printed surcharge, Dampening, Burden or other nonbase extra becomes pool credit even if paid. Base-only waivers can reduce creditableBase to0; Nexus/Ease allocations above may also reduce it. Protected X is fully paid separately and fully creditable.
AC5-PRICE-01.chargeOnlyBoundary: An ancestry/use-only spell spends its actual use and has no ordinary RP bucket unless another exact interface creates one. Nexus therefore cannot manufacture or discount a price. Accepted AC4 Dampening alone can add its +2 RP interface; final Influence may then modify that +2. A positive RP amount requires an existing lawful personal RP pool. Paying RP for a nonspell still does not make it a spell.

AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.classification: NEW extension limited to Greater Fire Pet and Faction Champion; does not alter AC4 Water Pet/Envoy scope
AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.rule: While either AC5 finite summoned body actually exists, treat it mechanically as an active creature and as a living ally for ordinary HP-healing/living-creature targeting, including Cleric Healing Rite. This does not establish natural biology, native plane, soul, corpse, breeding, nourishment, faction personhood or loot. A Null Disabled 0 body remains the same target while its original source persists and can be legally healed above 0. If the source has already ended/expired/replaced/dismissed the body, there is no target to heal.
AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.nullLifecycle: Bind both profiles to the accepted finiteSummonFamiliarMirrorBeast Null recipient branch: qualifying Null damage to 0 replaces only damage-caused disappearance with Disabled 0 while original source duration persists; later qualifying Null hits do not create organic death/Wounds; independent expiry/dismissal/concentration/replacement still ends the body. Ordinary non-Null damage reaching 0 uses the body's normal finite-summon disappearance.

AC5-ROOT-01.classification: NEW AC5 damage-root checkpoints consistent with accepted Null root ownership
AC5-ROOT-01.livingMagma: On a failed initial CON save that successfully establishes the recurring Living Magma rider, create one damage root immediately even though no initial damage packet occurs. Dealer is the caster. Record the caster's then-current unsuppressed Null Veil flag on that root. The three later tick packets are descendants and inherit the creation-time flag; later Veil changes do not rewrite it. A suppressed scheduled tick creates no child packet and is consumed with no makeup.
AC5-ROOT-01.greaterFirePetAttack: Each commanded Fire Pet attack that reaches its actual damage checkpoint creates a distinct root with dealer = Fire Pet body, not owner/controller.
AC5-ROOT-01.greaterFirePetAura: Each qualifying recipient's aura START checkpoint creates its own damage root with dealer = Fire Pet body. One shared d6 roll may feed several recipients but does not merge root identity or copy another actor's Veil. Evaluate the pet body's own Veil at each recipient root creation.
AC5-ROOT-01.massiveBlast: At instantaneous damage resolution create one root per original recipient, all with dealer = caster and the same cast ID. A shared 5d8 roll does not merge recipient roots.
AC5-ROOT-01.barrier: Damage prevention creates no damage root.

AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.classification: NEW scope extension only for Banish Elemental and Elemental Banishment; ordinary Banishment remains unchanged
reuse: BAN-ADMIT-03 current-space preflight, internal creation and legal visitor admission
ordinary Banishment custody/separate-creature and mandatory-body-ending rules
BAN-TRANSPORT-CLASS-02 planar/extradimensional nonteleport classification, copied only for these two AC5 exile applications
notReused: ordinary Banishment concentration when the AC5 spell authors another duration
AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.suppression: Actual suppression of the exile application closes/ends that application through reused closure; it never pauses and resumes exile.
AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.bodySourceEnding: If the primary finite creature source ends first, that body ends under its source, then the AC5 exile immediately closes. BAN-CLOSE-03 settles every remaining extant independently legal secondary body/corpse/object once; ended/absent bodies remain absent. Never settle only cargo when another extant identity exists, and never recreate the ended primary.
AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.intent: Before the printed CHA save record ACCEPT or RESIST exactly as ordinary Banishment. ACCEPT remains voluntary even if the target rolls and fails; RESIST+failed save is forced. For these two AC5 exiles, No Escape blocks ACCEPT because it names voluntary extradimensional travel; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not block because these applications are not teleportation. This is spell-local classification only.

AC5-PLANAR-META-01.classification: NEW spell/campaign metadata for Planar Protection, Planar Binding and Alignment Portal only; not a master cosmology
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.planeKey: An opaque stable ID for an actual plane record already established by campaign/source authority. The key carries no automatic alignment, deity, native-species, soul-destination, Wheel, dominion or tributary meaning.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.siteId: A stable known physical destination site on one planeKey with actual location/footprint/support data.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.travelProvenance: On a successful cross-plane body transition using a reviewed source, the Director may record currentBody.lastArrivedFromPlaneKey = the actual origin planeKey and the transport event ID. A creation source may instead explicitly provide createdFromPlaneKey. These are operational travel/source provenance only and do not establish native origin or soul identity.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.unknown: If a required planeKey/provenance fact is not established, it remains Indeterminate. Spells do not secretly discover or fabricate it.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.prospectiveArrival: For a particular cross-plane transition, snapshot prospectiveOriginPlaneKey = the actual planeKey containing the body immediately before that transit. Destination-side Planar Protection and other arrival predicates evaluate this immutable prospective value before placement. Only a successful atomic transition commits currentBody.lastArrivedFromPlaneKey = prospectiveOriginPlaneKey and the event ID. Failed/countered/blocked transit leaves prior provenance unchanged. createdFromPlaneKey remains creation provenance and is used for ordinary physical ward entry only when no current cross-plane transition supplies a prospective origin.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.partialFootprint: A destination/entry is ward-eligible if any part of the body/group terminal footprint would enter the protected sphere. All bodies in one carried/group transit are checked independently before atomic placement.

AC5-CHAMPION-ALLY-01.classification: NEW Faction Champion source-specific 'allied faction' gate
AC5-CHAMPION-ALLY-01.rule: Before payment choose one canonical factionId. Formation requires: (1) an actual spell-specific alliedStatus=true record for this caster/faction; (2) current standing > 0; (3) actual invocation permission under the current faction system; and (4) no explicit aid prohibition. Membership remains a separate credential and is not inferred from alliedStatus or standing. Faction Ally's membership+permission gate and Faction Portal's positive-standing+known-HQ gate remain distinct and are not imported.

AC5-ALIGN-PORTAL-META-01.classification: NEW Alignment Portal-specific compatibility metadata, not objective plane taxonomy
AC5-ALIGN-PORTAL-META-01.rule: An actual plane record may carry alignmentPortalCompatibility = a set of canonical nine-point alignment keys and one or more known Alignment-Portal siteIds. This is travel compatibility for this spell only. It does not assert that the plane is objectively 'Lawful Good', that a mortal Wheel label equals it, that inhabitants are native there, or that souls/deities map to it.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-SUMMON-01.classification: NEW suppression profile limited to Greater Fire Pet and Faction Champion
AC5-ANTIMAGIC-SUMMON-01.rule: While any part of one of these bodies intersects operative Lesser Antimagic, keep the same body identity, HP, source deadline, Null Disabled state and genuine cargo. Speed becomes 0 and the body cannot take Actions, companion commands, attacks or Fire-Pet aura checkpoints. Intrinsic manifested gear grants no separate function while suppressed. Genuine carried items remain the same items; if actual physical custody becomes impossible under ordinary item rules, place/drop them normally. Leaving suppression restores only still-live source permissions with the same HP/deadline and no refill/resummon.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03.classification: NEW Lesser Antimagic input/output checkpoints and protected-book interpretation; scoped only to this AC5 field
rule: At legal spell/effect commitment, costs/components/concentration/cadence resolve normally before suppression.
For an ongoing expression, suppress each local body/anchor/area portion that intersects the operative field.

For an instantaneous spell or magical nonspell originating outside, evaluate its actual recipient, affected area and/or destination manifestation checkpoint. Any local payload that would manifest inside the operative field is suppressed at resolution. Damage/healing inside creates no packet/root/rider; an indivisible relocation with a destination footprint intersecting the field fails atomically at origin. Outside-to-outside teleport/nonpath travel is unaffected even if an imaginary straight line crosses the sphere.
No fictional projectile/path is invented for nonprojectile effects. A genuine projectile/path that physically enters the field follows its own physical/magical source semantics.

An exact dispel effect whose selected target is the Lesser Antimagic application itself may address/end that field without being suppressed solely by the target field. It still needs its own legal source, cost, perception/range/LoE/check. Another separate Antimagic field can suppress the dispeller normally. This narrow self-dispel exception prevents an oscillating indispellable field and grants no passage to unrelated effects.

Wizard Spell Preservation: Antimagic may suppress magical spellbook usability/access effects while intersecting, but it does not erase the permanent class-source fact that the primary spellbook cannot be destroyed/erased/rendered permanently unreadable by non-artifact mundane or magical means. Suppression therefore does not create a window for permanent ordinary destruction. Artifact-level exceptions remain source-governed.
AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03.status: superseded by AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04 for current Repair04 operation semantics

AC5-PLANAR-ARRIVAL-03.classification: NEW AC5 prospective-arrival provenance timing; operational metadata only
AC5-PLANAR-ARRIVAL-03.rule: For every cross-plane transit into a Planar Protection destination, snapshot prospectiveOriginPlaneKey from the body’s actual plane immediately before the transit. Evaluate the destination ward against that value before placement, regardless of stale lastArrivedFromPlaneKey. On success commit lastArrivedFromPlaneKey=prospective origin; on failure keep the prior record unchanged. No failure reveals hidden provenance/cosmology beyond ordinary observed failure.

rule: Alignment Portal creates two fixed linked vertical apertures, each 5 feet wide by 8 feet high. At cast time record each aperture base-center, floor elevation and outward normal. Origin pose is chosen in a perceived clear supported space within60/LoE. Destination site metadata must already provide one known portalPose with clear supported 5-by-5 staging space on each side; missing pose/clearance makes the cast illegal rather than allowing remote tactical placement.

The gateway is bidirectional while active. A voluntary crossing is planar/extradimensional travel through a physical gateway and is NOT teleportation. No Escape blocks voluntary crossing; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not. This classification is Alignment-Portal-only.

Entering the aperture costs 5 feet of base ordinary movement. Apply actual terrain, crawling and squeezing costs to that 5-foot traversal. A Large body may use a 5-foot aperture only if ordinary one-size-smaller squeeze is legal; squeezing adds +1 movement cost per foot and its real penalties. Carried creatures are separate bodies and all members of one packet must fit/support and pass arrival blockers.

Forced movement may carry a body through only if the forcing source supplies enough real movement/path and the body/group passes all arrival gates. Forced movement spends no voluntary movement budget and does not become voluntary travel; No Escape therefore does not block the forced crossing merely by its voluntary wording.

Crossing maps the traveler’s facing relative to the entry normal to the corresponding destination exit normal. Destination placement is the nearest fitting unoccupied supported space touching the exit staging side, using fixed neutral board order for ties. No search through barriers and no body bisection.
AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-03.status: superseded by AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-04 for current Repair04 formation/crossing semantics

AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.classification: NEW Wall of Force resumption geometry only
AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.rule: Tessellate the authored wall from its fixed lower-left/local anchor into 2.5-foot by2.5-foot logical panels (edge remainders keep their exact smaller size). Antimagic suppresses the intersecting panel portions. On resumption, each panel/portion returns only if its 1-inch volume is clear. Occupied portions stay absent until clear; no push, cut, crush, arbitrary tactical hole or free squeeze is created. Once clear, the exact fixed portion resumes.
AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.status: superseded by AC5-WALL-PANELS-04 for current Repair04 resumption semantics

AC5-PLANAR-FALL-03.rule: Planar Protection supplies no support. If an eligible creature’s continuous ordinary Falling would cross inward and the last exterior boundary point is unsupported, the ward does not arrest or suspend that Fall Marker; the continuous fall may carry the body inside. Once inside, it is treated as already inside for this ward and may leave but cannot reenter after leaving while still eligible. Grounded/otherwise supported forced or voluntary crossings remain blocked at the last legal exterior position.

AC5-BINDING-ORDER-03.classification: NEW Planar Binding pending-order lifecycle only
rule: Each live binder→target record holds at most one pending service order. Issuance requires the binder and target on the same plane, a valid one-way command-intent channel, the binder’s real Bonus Action in initiative or one order opportunity per6 elapsed seconds outside initiative, and a currently source-legal simple order. Invalid issuance spends no order record; normal action-cost commitment follows the actual declaration rules.

A valid order receives its issue timestamp and binds the target’s next regular behavior opportunity after issue: next regular target turn/opportunity in initiative, or next six-second behavior pulse outside initiative. It expires at the end of that one opportunity whether executed, impossible, suppressed or budget-starved. No order is banked/replayed.

A later valid Binding order from the same binder before execution replaces that binder’s older pending Binding order; it does not erase other control effects. Plane change after a valid order does not erase the already-heard instruction, but plane separation prevents new issuance. Lesser Antimagic suppressing the Binding compulsion at the execution opportunity makes that order ineffective for the opportunity and it expires; the 24-hour service clock continues.

Companion/source gates remain prerequisites. Binding never creates the owner’s Companion Command, Action, Bonus Action, Reaction or offense token. If an owner legally opens one commanded companion damaging action and a pending Binding Attack order is compatible with that action but conflicts only on target choice, use Compelled Budget Arbitration/priority to constrain the one available action. If no source-gated action becomes available during the bound opportunity, the order expires without inventing one.

AC5-BARRIER-RECAST-03.classification: NEW Resonance Barrier same-name application/concentration lifecycle clarification
rule: Ordinary concentration transition occurs at the new cast’s legal commitment before Counterspell or fresh Barrier formation. Therefore a same-caster old Barrier that depended on that caster’s concentration ends at commitment and cannot survive a countered, failed, zero-pool or weaker replacement cast unless a future exact source expressly grants that exception.

If a still-live Barrier from a different caster protects the target, compare the fresh offered pool only at successful resolution. Stronger fresh pool replaces the retained application and ends the old Barrier application/concentration. Equal or weaker fresh offer does not replace/refresh the retained pool; the fresh Barrier application ends immediately at resolution and its new caster’s concentration on that application ends, with no refund.
Pool comparisons use remaining retained pool versus fresh offered initial pool. No two pools add.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04.classification: NEW Repair04 refinement of Lesser Antimagic input/output and dispel-operation capture; supersedes AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03 where inconsistent
rule: At legal spell/effect commitment, actual costs/components/concentration/cadence resolve before suppression. Ongoing local expressions remain suppressed only where their real body/anchor/area intersects the operative field.

For an instantaneous spell or magical nonspell originating outside, inspect its actual recipient, affected area and/or destination manifestation checkpoint. A local payload that would manifest in the field is suppressed at resolution. Damage/healing there creates no packet/root/rider; an indivisible relocation whose destination footprint intersects fails atomically at origin. Outside-to-outside nonpath travel is unaffected by an imaginary line through the sphere.

For Greater Dispel or another exact multi-effect dispel, first capture the immutable effect set under that source, then snapshot whether each individual captured termination operation is locally suppressed before performing any removal. A termination operation targeting one Lesser Antimagic application ignores suppression from that same target field only. Another independently active Antimagic field may still suppress that termination operation if its operative volume covers the relevant application/operation locus.

Do not re-evaluate a captured termination operation after earlier removals in the same dispel. Thus an inside captured buff whose termination operation was suppressed at the operation snapshot remains live even if the Antimagic field suppressing that operation is ended by another captured operation. There is no second scan or spring-back termination.
This self-dispel exception is operation-local. It neither makes unrelated payloads immune to Antimagic nor lets a dispeller ignore a different suppressing field.
No fictional projectile/path is invented for nonprojectile effects. Genuine projectiles/paths retain their source semantics.

Wizard Spell Preservation remains an intrinsic class protection of the primary spellbook: field suppression can make magical use/access unavailable locally but cannot create a non-artifact ordinary destruction loophole.

AC5-WALL-PANELS-04.classification: NEW Repair04 Wall of Force suppression/resumption geometry; supersedes AC5-WALL-PANELS-03 where inconsistent
rule: Tessellate the authored wall from its fixed lower-left/local anchor into 2.5-foot by 2.5-foot logical panels; exact edge remainders keep their smaller size.

While Antimagic or another exact suppressor overlaps the wall, suppress only the exact intersecting portion of each fixed panel and record that suppressed portion geometry. A portion of a panel that was not suppressed remains solid and cannot be entered merely because another portion is absent.

When suppression ends, process each recorded suppressed portion at its original fixed coordinates. If any part of that recorded portion's 1-inch wall volume intersects a creature or independent object, hold that entire recorded suppressed portion absent until clear. Do not generate a new body-shaped cutout and do not deactivate neighboring wall portions that remained solid.
Once the recorded portion is clear, that exact portion resumes. No push, cut, crush, tactical hole selection, free squeeze or movement is created.

AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-04.classification: NEW Repair04 refinement of Alignment Portal physical aperture/crossing; supersedes AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-03 where inconsistent
rule: Alignment Portal creates two fixed linked vertical apertures, each 5 feet wide by 8 feet high. At cast time record each aperture base-center, floor elevation and outward normal. Origin pose must be perceived, clear and supported within 60 feet/LoE. Destination site metadata must already supply a known portalPose with clear supported staging space sufficient for the intended known portal opening; portal creation itself transports no body or object.

A current Dimensional Anchor does not prevent the linked apertures from forming. Anchor is checked on each actual planar-transition transaction whose transported origin or destination footprint intersects the field; a known blocked crossing commits no movement, while a blocker appearing after legal crossing commitment yields atomic failure at origin under accepted Anchor.

The gateway is bidirectional while active. Voluntary crossing is planar/extradimensional physical-gateway travel and is NOT teleportation. No Escape blocks voluntary crossing; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not. This classification is Alignment-Portal-only.

Entering an aperture requires 5 feet of actual path through the gateway and ordinarily costs 5 feet of base movement. Use the accepted additive per-foot cost: terrain rate1 normal,2 difficult or3 severe (strongest terrain only), then add1 for crawling and1 for squeezing. A5ft traversal therefore costs5 times that sum; difficult+squeeze costs15ft, not20ft. A body must fit both the 5-foot width and 8-foot height under current posture/clearance rules. A Large 10x10 body may use ordinary one-size-smaller squeeze only when its stated height/pose and the actual aperture permit it; squeezing adds +1 movement cost per foot and keeps its real penalties.

Forced movement may cross only when the forcing source itself supplies a legal path and enough actual forced distance through the aperture. Do not infer that a Shove can force a body through a squeeze it could not otherwise physically clear. A fitting Medium body successfully Shoved 5 feet directly through the aperture is a sufficient forced-crossing fixture; forced movement is not voluntary, so No Escape's voluntary wording does not block that transit. All arrival gates still apply.

Crossing maps facing relative to entry normal to destination exit normal. Destination placement must fit the whole body in the actual supported staging space; fixed neutral board order breaks equivalent placements. No search through barriers and no body bisection.

completeCurrentCard.procedure:

Elemental type, outsider label and extraplanar provenance are irrelevant. A natural Elemental is not eligible merely for being Elemental; an eligible summoned non-Elemental can qualify. Hidden/unknown summon provenance may defeat a paid cast without diagnostic.

Commit ordinary costs/concentration/counter timing, then target makes CHA save. Success: no removal. Failure: require/spend the shared hard-control allowance; if unavailable no exile. On successful failed-save establishment, remove that same summoned enemy to an AC5-BANISH-EXT-01 cell for this spell's own concentration duration. Do not desummon it or send it to a home/native plane.

Use the accepted Banishment custody/real-clock/legal-escape/closure/body-placement interfaces only through AC5-BANISH-EXT-01. A separate carried creature is not gear and does not travel automatically. Genuine noncreature gear/cargo that legally accompanies the target remains the same inventory.

If the summon source itself ends/expires/dismisses/replaces the body while exiled, the body ends under that source; Elemental Banishment ends immediately and closes the cell, returning only surviving genuine loose cargo. Actual suppression of this exile application closes/ends it rather than pausing. Current endpoint blockers apply at establishment; terminal closure keeps the narrow accepted Banishment-only blocker exception through this explicit extension.

A creation source may instead explicitly provide createdFromPlaneKey. These are operational travel/source provenance only and do not establish native origin or soul identity.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.unknown: If a required planeKey/provenance fact is not established, it remains Indeterminate. Spells do not secretly discover or fabricate it.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.prospectiveArrival: For a particular cross-plane transition, snapshot prospectiveOriginPlaneKey = the actual planeKey containing the body immediately before that transit. Destination-side Planar Protection and other arrival predicates evaluate this immutable prospective value before placement. Only a successful atomic transition commits currentBody.lastArrivedFromPlaneKey = prospectiveOriginPlaneKey and the event ID. Failed/countered/blocked transit leaves prior provenance unchanged. createdFromPlaneKey remains creation provenance and is used for ordinary physical ward entry only when no current cross-plane transition supplies a prospective origin.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.partialFootprint: A destination/entry is ward-eligible if any part of the body/group terminal footprint would enter the protected sphere. All bodies in one carried/group transit are checked independently before atomic placement.

AC5-CHAMPION-ALLY-01.classification: NEW Faction Champion source-specific 'allied faction' gate
AC5-CHAMPION-ALLY-01.rule: Before payment choose one canonical factionId. Formation requires: (1) an actual spell-specific alliedStatus=true record for this caster/faction; (2) current standing > 0; (3) actual invocation permission under the current faction system; and (4) no explicit aid prohibition. Membership remains a separate credential and is not inferred from alliedStatus or standing. Faction Ally's membership+permission gate and Faction Portal's positive-standing+known-HQ gate remain distinct and are not imported.

AC5-ALIGN-PORTAL-META-01.classification: NEW Alignment Portal-specific compatibility metadata, not objective plane taxonomy
AC5-ALIGN-PORTAL-META-01.rule: An actual plane record may carry alignmentPortalCompatibility = a set of canonical nine-point alignment keys and one or more known Alignment-Portal siteIds. This is travel compatibility for this spell only. It does not assert that the plane is objectively 'Lawful Good', that a mortal Wheel label equals it, that inhabitants are native there, or that souls/deities map to it.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-SUMMON-01.classification: NEW suppression profile limited to Greater Fire Pet and Faction Champion
AC5-ANTIMAGIC-SUMMON-01.rule: While any part of one of these bodies intersects operative Lesser Antimagic, keep the same body identity, HP, source deadline, Null Disabled state and genuine cargo. Speed becomes 0 and the body cannot take Actions, companion commands, attacks or Fire-Pet aura checkpoints. Intrinsic manifested gear grants no separate function while suppressed. Genuine carried items remain the same items; if actual physical custody becomes impossible under ordinary item rules, place/drop them normally. Leaving suppression restores only still-live source permissions with the same HP/deadline and no refill/resummon.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03.classification: NEW Lesser Antimagic input/output checkpoints and protected-book interpretation; scoped only to this AC5 field
rule: At legal spell/effect commitment, costs/components/concentration/cadence resolve normally before suppression.
For an ongoing expression, suppress each local body/anchor/area portion that intersects the operative field.

For an instantaneous spell or magical nonspell originating outside, evaluate its actual recipient, affected area and/or destination manifestation checkpoint. Any local payload that would manifest inside the operative field is suppressed at resolution. Damage/healing inside creates no packet/root/rider; an indivisible relocation with a destination footprint intersecting the field fails atomically at origin. Outside-to-outside teleport/nonpath travel is unaffected even if an imaginary straight line crosses the sphere.
No fictional projectile/path is invented for nonprojectile effects. A genuine projectile/path that physically enters the field follows its own physical/magical source semantics.

An exact dispel effect whose selected target is the Lesser Antimagic application itself may address/end that field without being suppressed solely by the target field. It still needs its own legal source, cost, perception/range/LoE/check. Another separate Antimagic field can suppress the dispeller normally. This narrow self-dispel exception prevents an oscillating indispellable field and grants no passage to unrelated effects.

Wizard Spell Preservation: Antimagic may suppress magical spellbook usability/access effects while intersecting, but it does not erase the permanent class-source fact that the primary spellbook cannot be destroyed/erased/rendered permanently unreadable by non-artifact mundane or magical means. Suppression therefore does not create a window for permanent ordinary destruction. Artifact-level exceptions remain source-governed.
AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03.status: superseded by AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04 for current Repair04 operation semantics

AC5-PLANAR-ARRIVAL-03.classification: NEW AC5 prospective-arrival provenance timing; operational metadata only
AC5-PLANAR-ARRIVAL-03.rule: For every cross-plane transit into a Planar Protection destination, snapshot prospectiveOriginPlaneKey from the body’s actual plane immediately before the transit. Evaluate the destination ward against that value before placement, regardless of stale lastArrivedFromPlaneKey. On success commit lastArrivedFromPlaneKey=prospective origin; on failure keep the prior record unchanged. No failure reveals hidden provenance/cosmology beyond ordinary observed failure.

rule: Alignment Portal creates two fixed linked vertical apertures, each 5 feet wide by 8 feet high. At cast time record each aperture base-center, floor elevation and outward normal. Origin pose is chosen in a perceived clear supported space within60/LoE. Destination site metadata must already provide one known portalPose with clear supported 5-by-5 staging space on each side; missing pose/clearance makes the cast illegal rather than allowing remote tactical placement.

The gateway is bidirectional while active. A voluntary crossing is planar/extradimensional travel through a physical gateway and is NOT teleportation. No Escape blocks voluntary crossing; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not. This classification is Alignment-Portal-only.

Entering the aperture costs 5 feet of base ordinary movement. Apply actual terrain, crawling and squeezing costs to that 5-foot traversal. A Large body may use a 5-foot aperture only if ordinary one-size-smaller squeeze is legal; squeezing adds +1 movement cost per foot and its real penalties. Carried creatures are separate bodies and all members of one packet must fit/support and pass arrival blockers.

Forced movement may carry a body through only if the forcing source supplies enough real movement/path and the body/group passes all arrival gates. Forced movement spends no voluntary movement budget and does not become voluntary travel; No Escape therefore does not block the forced crossing merely by its voluntary wording.

Crossing maps the traveler’s facing relative to the entry normal to the corresponding destination exit normal. Destination placement is the nearest fitting unoccupied supported space touching the exit staging side, using fixed neutral board order for ties. No search through barriers and no body bisection.
AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-03.status: superseded by AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-04 for current Repair04 formation/crossing semantics

AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.classification: NEW Wall of Force resumption geometry only
AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.rule: Tessellate the authored wall from its fixed lower-left/local anchor into 2.5-foot by2.5-foot logical panels (edge remainders keep their exact smaller size). Antimagic suppresses the intersecting panel portions. On resumption, each panel/portion returns only if its 1-inch volume is clear. Occupied portions stay absent until clear; no push, cut, crush, arbitrary tactical hole or free squeeze is created. Once clear, the exact fixed portion resumes.
AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.status: superseded by AC5-WALL-PANELS-04 for current Repair04 resumption semantics

AC5-PLANAR-FALL-03.rule: Planar Protection supplies no support. If an eligible creature’s continuous ordinary Falling would cross inward and the last exterior boundary point is unsupported, the ward does not arrest or suspend that Fall Marker; the continuous fall may carry the body inside. Once inside, it is treated as already inside for this ward and may leave but cannot reenter after leaving while still eligible. Grounded/otherwise supported forced or voluntary crossings remain blocked at the last legal exterior position.

AC5-BINDING-ORDER-03.classification: NEW Planar Binding pending-order lifecycle only
rule: Each live binder→target record holds at most one pending service order. Issuance requires the binder and target on the same plane, a valid one-way command-intent channel, the binder’s real Bonus Action in initiative or one order opportunity per6 elapsed seconds outside initiative, and a currently source-legal simple order. Invalid issuance spends no order record; normal action-cost commitment follows the actual declaration rules.

A valid order receives its issue timestamp and binds the target’s next regular behavior opportunity after issue: next regular target turn/opportunity in initiative, or next six-second behavior pulse outside initiative. It expires at the end of that one opportunity whether executed, impossible, suppressed or budget-starved. No order is banked/replayed.

A later valid Binding order from the same binder before execution replaces that binder’s older pending Binding order; it does not erase other control effects. Plane change after a valid order does not erase the already-heard instruction, but plane separation prevents new issuance. Lesser Antimagic suppressing the Binding compulsion at the execution opportunity makes that order ineffective for the opportunity and it expires; the 24-hour service clock continues.

Companion/source gates remain prerequisites. Binding never creates the owner’s Companion Command, Action, Bonus Action, Reaction or offense token. If an owner legally opens one commanded companion damaging action and a pending Binding Attack order is compatible with that action but conflicts only on target choice, use Compelled Budget Arbitration/priority to constrain the one available action. If no source-gated action becomes available during the bound opportunity, the order expires without inventing one.

AC5-BARRIER-RECAST-03.classification: NEW Resonance Barrier same-name application/concentration lifecycle clarification
rule: Ordinary concentration transition occurs at the new cast’s legal commitment before Counterspell or fresh Barrier formation. Therefore a same-caster old Barrier that depended on that caster’s concentration ends at commitment and cannot survive a countered, failed, zero-pool or weaker replacement cast unless a future exact source expressly grants that exception.

If a still-live Barrier from a different caster protects the target, compare the fresh offered pool only at successful resolution. Stronger fresh pool replaces the retained application and ends the old Barrier application/concentration. Equal or weaker fresh offer does not replace/refresh the retained pool; the fresh Barrier application ends immediately at resolution and its new caster’s concentration on that application ends, with no refund.
Pool comparisons use remaining retained pool versus fresh offered initial pool. No two pools add.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04.classification: NEW Repair04 refinement of Lesser Antimagic input/output and dispel-operation capture; supersedes AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03 where inconsistent
rule: At legal spell/effect commitment, actual costs/components/concentration/cadence resolve before suppression. Ongoing local expressions remain suppressed only where their real body/anchor/area intersects the operative field.

For an instantaneous spell or magical nonspell originating outside, inspect its actual recipient, affected area and/or destination manifestation checkpoint. A local payload that would manifest in the field is suppressed at resolution. Damage/healing there creates no packet/root/rider; an indivisible relocation whose destination footprint intersects fails atomically at origin. Outside-to-outside nonpath travel is unaffected by an imaginary line through the sphere.

For Greater Dispel or another exact multi-effect dispel, first capture the immutable effect set under that source, then snapshot whether each individual captured termination operation is locally suppressed before performing any removal. A termination operation targeting one Lesser Antimagic application ignores suppression from that same target field only. Another independently active Antimagic field may still suppress that termination operation if its operative volume covers the relevant application/operation locus.

Do not re-evaluate a captured termination operation after earlier removals in the same dispel. Thus an inside captured buff whose termination operation was suppressed at the operation snapshot remains live even if the Antimagic field suppressing that operation is ended by another captured operation. There is no second scan or spring-back termination.
This self-dispel exception is operation-local. It neither makes unrelated payloads immune to Antimagic nor lets a dispeller ignore a different suppressing field.
No fictional projectile/path is invented for nonprojectile effects. Genuine projectiles/paths retain their source semantics.

Wizard Spell Preservation remains an intrinsic class protection of the primary spellbook: field suppression can make magical use/access unavailable locally but cannot create a non-artifact ordinary destruction loophole.

AC5-WALL-PANELS-04.classification: NEW Repair04 Wall of Force suppression/resumption geometry; supersedes AC5-WALL-PANELS-03 where inconsistent
rule: Tessellate the authored wall from its fixed lower-left/local anchor into 2.5-foot by 2.5-foot logical panels; exact edge remainders keep their smaller size.

While Antimagic or another exact suppressor overlaps the wall, suppress only the exact intersecting portion of each fixed panel and record that suppressed portion geometry. A portion of a panel that was not suppressed remains solid and cannot be entered merely because another portion is absent.

When suppression ends, process each recorded suppressed portion at its original fixed coordinates. If any part of that recorded portion's 1-inch wall volume intersects a creature or independent object, hold that entire recorded suppressed portion absent until clear. Do not generate a new body-shaped cutout and do not deactivate neighboring wall portions that remained solid.
Once the recorded portion is clear, that exact portion resumes. No push, cut, crush, tactical hole selection, free squeeze or movement is created.

AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-04.classification: NEW Repair04 refinement of Alignment Portal physical aperture/crossing; supersedes AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-03 where inconsistent
rule: Alignment Portal creates two fixed linked vertical apertures, each 5 feet wide by 8 feet high. At cast time record each aperture base-center, floor elevation and outward normal. Origin pose must be perceived, clear and supported within 60 feet/LoE. Destination site metadata must already supply a known portalPose with clear supported staging space sufficient for the intended known portal opening; portal creation itself transports no body or object.

A current Dimensional Anchor does not prevent the linked apertures from forming. Anchor is checked on each actual planar-transition transaction whose transported origin or destination footprint intersects the field; a known blocked crossing commits no movement, while a blocker appearing after legal crossing commitment yields atomic failure at origin under accepted Anchor.

The gateway is bidirectional while active. Voluntary crossing is planar/extradimensional physical-gateway travel and is NOT teleportation. No Escape blocks voluntary crossing; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not. This classification is Alignment-Portal-only.

Entering an aperture requires 5 feet of actual path through the gateway and ordinarily costs 5 feet of base movement. Use the accepted additive per-foot cost: terrain rate1 normal,2 difficult or3 severe (strongest terrain only), then add1 for crawling and1 for squeezing. A5ft traversal therefore costs5 times that sum; difficult+squeeze costs15ft, not20ft. A body must fit both the 5-foot width and 8-foot height under current posture/clearance rules. A Large 10x10 body may use ordinary one-size-smaller squeeze only when its stated height/pose and the actual aperture permit it; squeezing adds +1 movement cost per foot and keeps its real penalties.

Forced movement may cross only when the forcing source itself supplies a legal path and enough actual forced distance through the aperture. Do not infer that a Shove can force a body through a squeeze it could not otherwise physically clear. A fitting Medium body successfully Shoved 5 feet directly through the aperture is a sufficient forced-crossing fixture; forced movement is not voluntary, so No Escape's voluntary wording does not block that transit. All arrival gates still apply.

Crossing maps facing relative to entry normal to destination exit normal. Destination placement must fit the whole body in the actual supported staging space; fixed neutral board order breaks equivalent placements. No search through barriers and no body bisection.

completeCurrentCard.name: Faction Portal

operational.targets: One legal open local entrance space you perceive within 60 feet and line of effect, on suitable ground. Choose one exact canonical factionId with a recorded current reputation score above 0 and one specific known headquarters of that faction.
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; preserve the virtual phase through initiative changes, absence, death and planar travel. Outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application, retaining that absolute deadline when entering initiative. An already-passed start does not count. Ends earlier if concentration ends.
operational.resolution: No roll. On successful casting create one visible, fixed, one-way doorway 5 feet wide and8 feet high. The destination is a known established public/default receiving point for the chosen headquarters, or, absent such a point, one specific known ordinary primary entrance/foyer. Identify it from personal experience or reliable public information; no existing portal infrastructure is needed. It may be on the same or another plane. Recheck each actual crossing against legal arrival space and exact teleport/planar blockers; failure leaves the crossing creature and belongings at the local entrance, with no split or deletion.
operational.effect:
Any creature that physically fits the entrance under ordinary anatomy/squeezing rules may use it; passengers need no positive reputation or faction membership. Entering costs 5 feet of ordinary movement, subject to ordinary movement-cost adjustments, and atomically transports that creature and its legally carried belongings to a legal unoccupied space at or adjacent to the chosen receiving point. Ordinary carried creatures may accompany it only within the carrier's actual anatomy, pound and Load capacity and with room for the whole arriving group; this does not create willing-target immunity against being actually carried. Choose the receiving point when casting and keep it fixed. At each crossing use the nearest legal space at/adjacent to that point that fits the whole group, with a fixed neutral board order for ties, never a tactical remote choice or search through barriers. If none exists, the crossing fails and the attempted movement remains spent. Ordinary approach movement can provoke opportunity attacks; the teleport transition itself cannot. Items carried through remain the same items with actual ownership, contents, conditions and provenance. Loose unattended objects do not independently activate transit: a creature must physically carry or legally handle them as part of its own crossing; thrown projectiles, remote pushes and spells cannot deliver goods through by themselves.

The doorway is opaque to sight and sound and supplies no line of effect through it. Attacks, spells, areas, projectiles and remote sensing do not pass. There is no exit doorway or automatic return route. Complete a currently resolving legal crossing atomically before closing/suppressing the doorway; expiry never bisects a body or cargo. Later crossings require the still-active doorway. Suppression makes it unusable without pausing its endpoint. It has no physical HP, support or barrier body; when inactive there is no active transit surface. One portal per caster; a successful replacement closes the old one. Current positive reputation is checked as a creation gate at cast start and resolution, not a continuing passenger credential; a later standing change does not itself close a created portal.
operational.limitations: Use the actual canonical reputation record: positive means above 0, normally+1 through+3 under REPUTATION.md; missing/0/negative standing fails the gate. This card does not replace that scale with the historical Gameplay Loop's -5..+5 scale. No faction membership, Seal invocation permission, headquarters infrastructure or automatic entry authorization is added. If there are several HQs, select exactly one known site; no hidden vault, secret room, unknown HQ, location search or knowledge report. The far endpoint needs no originating line of sight/effect and has no geographic range ceiling, but actual wards and legal placement still apply. A headquarters that ceases to exist or belong to the faction cannot receive new crossings; a purely clerical name change does not move the chosen physical point. Failed crossings reveal no cause beyond failure, although ordinary observers may draw inferences. The spell can bypass a geographic route leg and deliver people to Haven when that actual HQ is there. It never automatically completes Extraction, advances or resets the Opening clock, settles cargo claims, removes contamination, changes ownership/reputation, grants credentials, ignores guards/laws/taxes or refunds cast costs. No free actions, additional capacity, object duplication or attacker path across planes. A successful replacement has its own endpoint; stale cleanup cannot end the new application. A countered cast creates no replacement, although its concentration transition has already occurred. Actual class access, rank, preparation, V/S/F components, casting costs, Dissonance/Refrain, class hooks, concentration transitions and counter windows follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Costs and beginning hooks commit before interruption, with no refunds or restoration of prior concentration. Direct target selection and local creation require the printed line of effect; expressly remote teleport destinations use their own printed rules. No generic upcast or unstated scaling.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/60 feet/V,S,F, doorway to a faction headquarters with positive reputation, actual planar travel supported by Planar tag. CONFLICT RULING: Core Instantaneous metadata becomes NEW 1 minute concentration for a usable doorway. NEW: known ordinary receiving-site procedure, fixed one-way 5 x 8 ft entrance, local 5 foot movement cost, whole-group atomic arrival, opaque transport-only interface, any-passenger use, no later reputation tether and exact destination legality. Canon positive predicate is retained without silently changing the reputation scale; route bypass remains possible while actual settlement procedures persist.
operational.implementationStatus: REVIEWED authored operational-playtest manuscript; runtime, travel-system implementation, numerical balance and whole-game validation pending

completeCurrentCard.procedure:
Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F; base 10 RP; source Instantaneous metadata preserved. Preserve the printed effect: a genuine gateway to a plane compatible with the caster’s alignment. NEW finite completion: concentration up to 60 elapsed seconds and two fixed linked 5-foot-wide ×8-foot-high vertical apertures.

Before payment: (1) compute the caster’s current effective canonical nine-point alignment only when both axes are defined, applying underlying records/AP-AS-01 then AC4 Lock/Anchor snapshots under AC4-ALIGN-01; (2) choose a different actual destination `planeKey` and genuinely known `siteId`; (3) that plane/site record must carry Alignment-Portal compatibility for the effective alignment; (4) use AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-04 to choose a perceived clear supported origin pose and the site’s already-recorded destination `portalPose`. The gateway is bidirectional while active. Ordinary sight may see through only where geometry permits, but the portal grants no cross-plane spell/attack/remote-sense line of effect; its permission is physical crossing.

Transport classification for this spell only: crossing is planar/extradimensional physical-gateway travel and is NOT teleportation. Therefore No Escape blocks a voluntary crossing; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not. Forced movement can carry a body through only under AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-04 and is not voluntary.

Crossing one aperture costs 5 feet base ordinary movement, modified by actual difficult terrain/crawling/squeezing. Large through the 5-foot aperture requires legal one-size-smaller squeeze and pays the real squeeze movement/penalties. Carried creatures are separate travelers; all bodies must fit/support and pass blockers. Use prospective arrival provenance from AC5-PLANAR-ARRIVAL-03 for destination Planar Protection before placement. At each crossing, revalidate the actual origin/destination body footprints, occupancy/support, current Dimensional Anchor and destination ward. A known Anchor-blocked crossing commits no movement; a live portal can remain present until its normal deadline. Known illegal crossing commits no 5-foot movement; legality changing after a legal crossing commitment yields atomic failure at origin with no split/bisection.

Successful transit commits `lastArrivedFromPlaneKey` to the actual origin planeKey only. Transit completed before deadline completes; at deadline no new crossing begins. Suppression makes apertures unusable without pausing deadline and never ejects a traveler. No return exists after closure, but while active either aperture can be used in either direction under the same real gates. No cosmological/native/soul/deity fact is inferred.
